items.ja: 私は違う見方をしています。I disagree より柔らかく、しかし立場は明確
items.example: I see it differently. The data says the delay is in approvals, not engineering.
items.when: 相手の結論に異議を唱える最初の一言

items.en: Can I push back on that?
items.ja: それに異論を言ってもいい? 反論の前置きとして米国の会議で頻出
items.example: Can I push back on that? Moving the date costs us the Q4 deal.
items.when: 上司や顧客にも使える丁寧な反論の切り出し

items.ja: そこは論理がつながっていない気がする
items.example: I'm not sure that follows. Fewer tickets doesn't mean happier customers.
items.when: 結論の飛躍を指摘するとき

items.ja: 私の懸念はこうです。反対ではなく懸念として伝える型
items.example: Here's my concern: if we cut testing, we'll ship the same bug again.
items.when: 賛成しきれない理由を一つに絞って言う

items.ja: もっともな点だが…。受け止めてから返す
items.example: That's a fair point, but the timeline doesn't change the budget problem.
items.when: 相手の指摘を認めつつ主張を続ける

items.ja: その2つを混同しないようにしよう
items.example: Let's not conflate the two. Price and quality are separate decisions.
items.when: 議論が混ざってきたときに整理する

items.ja: むしろ逆だと思う
items.example: I'd argue the opposite. A smaller launch gets us better feedback.
items.when: 相手と正反対の見解を率直に出す

items.ja: その根拠は? 感情でなく根拠を求める
items.example: What's the evidence for that? Last quarter's numbers say otherwise.
items.when: 主張が感覚ベースに見えるとき

items.en: I hear you, and I still think we should wait.
items.ja: 言いたいことは分かる、それでも待つべきだと思う
items.example: I hear you, and I still think we should wait until the audit is done.
items.when: 相手の意見を聞いた上で結論を変えない

items.ja: 代案を出させてください。反対だけで終わらない
items.example: Let me offer an alternative: pilot it with one team first.
items.when: 反対の直後に必ず添える一言

items.ja: レポート、何か進展は? 催促の最も軽い形
items.example: Hey Jen, any update on the Q3 report?

items.ja: この件の様子を見に来ました。メールの催促の定番
items.example: Just checking in on this. Do you have an ETA?
items.when: 返事がないときの2回目

items.en: Where do we stand on the contract?
items.ja: 契約の件はどこまで進んでいる?
items.example: Where do we stand on the contract? Legal needs it by Friday.
items.when: 状況を具体的に聞きたいとき

items.en: I need this by end of day.
items.ja: 今日中に必要です。期限を明確に
items.example: I need this by end of day, or the deck goes out without your numbers.
items.when: 期限が本当に迫っているとき

items.ja: 何が止めている? 相手を責めずに障害を聞く
items.example: What's blocking you? If it's approvals, I can escalate.
items.when: 遅れの原因を一緒に取り除きたいとき

items.en: Can you give me an ETA?
items.ja: 完了見込みを教えてもらえる?
items.example: Can you give me an ETA? Even a rough one helps.
items.when: いつ出てくるかだけ知りたいとき

items.ja: これはもう急ぎの案件です
items.example: This is now time-sensitive. The client meeting moved to Monday.
items.when: 優先度が上がったことを伝える

items.en: Bumping this to the top of your inbox.
items.ja: 受信箱の一番上に上げておきます(=再送して催促)
items.example: Bumping this to the top of your inbox. Still waiting on the signed copy.
items.when: メールの再送時の一言

items.en: Let's get this over the line.
items.ja: これを完了まで持っていこう
items.example: We're ninety percent there. Let's get this over the line this week.
items.when: 最後のひと押しを促す

items.en: I'll follow up tomorrow if I don't hear back.
items.ja: 返事がなければ明日また連絡します
items.example: No rush today, but I'll follow up tomorrow if I don't hear back.
items.when: 催促を予告して圧をかけすぎない

items.ja: それは約束できない
items.example: I can't commit to that by Friday. The team is on the Garcia launch.
items.when: 期限や内容が無理なとき

items.en: That's not something I can take on right now.
items.ja: 今は引き受けられる案件ではない
items.example: That's not something I can take on right now, but I can in May.
items.when: 丁寧に、しかし明確に断る

items.en: I don't have the bandwidth this week.
items.ja: 今週は手が空いていない
items.example: I don't have the bandwidth this week. Can it wait until Monday?
items.when: 忙しさを理由に断る定番

items.en: Here's what I can do instead.
items.ja: 代わりにできるのはこれです
items.example: I can't do the whole deck. Here's what I can do instead: the two data slides.
items.when: 断りの直後に代案を出す

items.en: That's out of scope for this phase.
items.ja: それは今回の範囲外です
items.example: That's out of scope for this phase. Let's log it for phase two.
items.when: 追加要望を線引きする

items.ja: やりたくない。短く率直な断り
items.example: Share the raw data with them? I'd rather not until we've checked it.
items.when: 親しい同僚相手に理由つきで

items.ja: 今回は無理、ごめん
items.example: Not this time, sorry. I've got back-to-back calls all afternoon.
items.when: 軽い誘いや頼みを断る

items.en: If I say yes to this, something else slips.
items.ja: これを受けると別の何かが遅れる
items.example: If I say yes to this, the audit slips. Which one matters more to you?
items.when: 優先順位を相手に決めさせる

items.en: Let me be upfront: that's not going to work.
items.ja: 率直に言うと、それはうまくいかない
items.example: Let me be upfront: that's not going to work with our current staffing.
items.when: 回りくどさを避けて断る

items.ja: 今回は見送ります
items.example: Thanks for thinking of me, but I'll pass on this one.
items.when: 参加や役割を辞退する

items.en: What's your best price on this?
items.ja: これの最安値はいくら?
items.example: What's your best price on this if we order five hundred?
items.when: 値引き交渉の最初の一言

items.ja: 予算より高い
items.example: That's higher than we budgeted. Where can we trim?

items.ja: 中間で手を打てます
items.example: We can meet you halfway on price if you extend the term to two years.
items.when: 譲歩を条件付きで出す

items.ja: それは当方には受け入れられない条件です
items.example: A two-year lock-in is a deal-breaker for us.
items.when: 絶対に譲れない点を明示

items.en: Can you throw in the training?
items.ja: 研修をつけてもらえる?
items.example: If the price stays, can you throw in the onsite training?

items.ja: それを書面にしましょう
items.example: Good. Let's put that in writing before we move on.
items.when: 口約束を契約に落とす

items.en: We're close, but not there yet.
items.ja: 近いが、まだ合意には至っていない
items.example: We're close, but not there yet. The payment terms still don't work.
items.when: 交渉の中盤で現状を整理

items.en: I'm not in a position to agree to that.
items.ja: それに同意できる立場にない
items.example: I'm not in a position to agree to that without my director.
items.when: 権限を理由に即答を避ける

items.en: If you can do X, we can do Y.
items.ja: そちらがXなら、こちらはY
items.example: If you can do net sixty, we can do the larger order.

items.en: We'll walk away if the terms don't change.
items.ja: 条件が変わらなければ手を引く
items.example: To be clear, we'll walk away if the terms don't change.
items.when: 最後の圧力。本気のときだけ

items.ja: 今週はどう? 月曜以外の万能な出だし
items.example: Hey! How's your week going so far?

items.ja: 週末は何か予定ある?
items.example: Any plans for the weekend, or just taking it easy?

items.ja: 今週はめちゃくちゃ忙しい
items.example: Honestly, I'm swamped this week. Two launches at once.

items.ja: ほんとそれ。同意の相づち
items.example: The traffic was awful. — Tell me about it. Took me an hour.

items.ja: コーヒーが欲しい(誘いにもなる)
items.example: I could use a coffee. Want to come?

items.ja: 出張(旅行)どうだった?
items.example: How was the trip? Did you get any sleep?

items.ja: それ最高に面白い
items.example: He wore the badge upside down all day? That's hilarious.

items.en: I'm a big fan of that place.
items.ja: あの店、大好きなんだ
items.example: The taco truck? I'm a big fan of that place.
items.when: 好みを伝えて会話を広げる

items.en: I should get back to it.
items.ja: そろそろ戻らないと
items.example: Anyway, I should get back to it. Good catching up.

items.ja: 話せてよかった
items.example: Good catching up. Let's do lunch next week.

items.en: Could you do me a favor?
items.ja: お願いがあるんだけど
items.example: Could you do me a favor and review this before noon?

items.en: I need your eyes on this.
items.ja: これを見てほしい(チェックしてほしい)
items.example: I need your eyes on this contract before it goes out.

items.en: Can you take the lead on this?
items.ja: この件、主導してもらえる?
items.example: Can you take the lead on the vendor evaluation?

items.en: Would you mind looping in Sarah?
items.ja: サラを話に入れてもらえる?
items.example: Would you mind looping in Sarah? She owns the budget.

items.ja: 早めに返してもらえると助かる
items.example: I'd appreciate a quick turnaround; the client is waiting.

items.en: Can you walk me through it?
items.ja: 順を追って説明してもらえる?
items.example: Can you walk me through how the approval works?

items.ja: 進捗を共有して
items.example: Keep me in the loop on the negotiation.

items.en: Give me a heads-up if anything changes.
items.ja: 何か変わったら先に教えて
items.example: Give me a heads-up if the date changes.

items.en: Can you cover for me on Friday?
items.ja: 金曜、代わりをお願いできる?
items.example: Can you cover for me on Friday? I have a doctor's appointment.

items.ja: 急がないけど…。圧をかけずに頼む
items.example: No rush, but could you send me the slides when you get a chance?

items.ja: 一つ注意喚起したいことがある
items.example: I want to flag something: the vendor missed the first milestone.
items.when: 悪い知らせの切り出し

items.ja: 問題にぶつかった
items.example: We hit a snag with the data migration. Nothing lost, but we're a day behind.
items.when: 小さめのトラブル報告

items.en: Here's what happened, and here's what we're doing.
items.ja: 起きたことと、対応はこうです
items.example: Here's what happened, and here's what we're doing: the server failed; we've switched to backup.

items.en: We don't have a root cause yet.
items.ja: 根本原因はまだ分かっていない
items.example: We don't have a root cause yet, and I don't want to guess.

items.en: I'll have an update by five.
items.ja: 5時までに報告します
items.example: I'll have an update by five, whether we've fixed it or not.

items.ja: 影響範囲は…に限られる
items.example: The impact is limited to the Chicago office. Everyone else is fine.
items.when: 被害の大きさを先に示す

items.ja: これは私の責任です
items.example: I own this. The checklist was mine to review.

items.en: It won't happen again. Here's why.
items.ja: 再発はしません。理由はこうです
items.example: It won't happen again. Here's why: we added a second approver.

items.en: I'd rather tell you now than surprise you later.
items.ja: 後で驚かせるより、今言っておきたい
items.example: We may slip a week. I'd rather tell you now than surprise you later.
items.when: 早めの悪い知らせの前置き

items.ja: 最悪の場合は…
items.example: Worst case, we ship without the reporting feature and add it in March.
items.when: 最悪シナリオを先に示す

items.ja: 私の提案はこうです
items.example: Here's what I'm proposing: one pilot store, six weeks, then decide.

items.ja: 利点は…
items.example: The upside is we cut lead time in half.

items.ja: リスクは管理できる範囲です
items.example: The risk is manageable; we can roll back in an hour.
items.when: 懸念を先回りして潰す

items.en: What would it take to get a yes?
items.ja: 承認してもらうには何が必要ですか?
items.example: What would it take to get a yes from finance?

items.ja: 小さく始めて広げよう
items.example: Let's start small and scale once the numbers hold.

items.ja: 法務にはもう確認済みです
items.example: I've already checked with legal; the clause is fine.

items.en: If we don't do this, here's what happens.
items.ja: やらなければこうなります
items.example: If we don't do this, we lose the account by Q2.
items.when: 不作為のコストを示す

items.ja: 承認をいただけますか?
items.example: Can I get your sign-off so we can start Monday?

items.ja: 結果には私が責任を持ちます
items.example: Give me the green light and I'll own the outcome.

items.ja: 今日決めよう
items.example: We have the data. Let's decide today.

items.ja: 私の推奨は待つことです
items.example: My recommendation is to wait until the audit closes.
items.when: 意見を推奨として出す

items.ja: それには賛成しかねる(気が進まない)
items.example: I'm not comfortable with shipping untested code.

items.en: That doesn't sit right with me.
items.ja: それは腑に落ちない
items.example: Charging them twice doesn't sit right with me.

items.en: Let's be honest about the numbers.
items.ja: 数字について正直になろう
items.example: Let's be honest about the numbers: we won't hit the target.

items.ja: 私ならBを選ぶ
items.example: I'd go with option B. It's cheaper and faster.

items.en: Bottom line, we need more people.
items.ja: 要するに、人が足りない
items.example: Bottom line, we need two more engineers.

items.ja: やらないことを強く勧める
items.example: I strongly suggest we don't announce before legal signs off.

items.ja: それが私の見解です
items.example: We should pass on the deal. That's my take.

items.ja: 間違っているかもしれないが…。断定を和らげる
items.example: I could be wrong, but I think the spec changed last week.

items.ja: 率直に言わせてください
items.example: Let me be direct: the plan has no owner.

items.theme: 相手の意図を確認する
items.en: Just to confirm, you mean next Friday?
items.ja: 確認ですが、来週の金曜ということ?
items.example: Just to confirm, you mean next Friday, not this one?

items.theme: 相手の意図を確認する
items.ja: 「すぐ」とは具体的にいつ?
items.example: What do you mean by 'soon'? This week, or this month?

items.theme: 相手の意図を確認する
items.en: So you're saying we should wait?
items.ja: つまり待つべきだということ?
items.example: So you're saying we should wait for the audit?

items.theme: 相手の意図を確認する
items.en: Can you say that another way?
items.ja: 別の言い方で言ってもらえる?
items.example: Sorry, can you say that another way? I want to make sure I follow.
items.when: 聞き取れなかったとき

items.theme: 相手の意図を確認する
items.en: Let me make sure I've got this right.
items.ja: 正しく理解できているか確認させて
items.example: Let me make sure I've got this right: one order now, no second shipment.
items.when: 自分の言葉で言い直す

items.theme: 相手の意図を確認する
items.ja: それは絶対の期限?
items.example: Is that a hard deadline, or is there some flexibility?

items.theme: 相手の意図を確認する
items.ja: ここでの決定権者は誰?
items.example: Who's the decision-maker here? I want to brief the right person.

items.theme: 相手の意図を確認する
items.en: What does success look like for you?
items.ja: あなたにとっての成功とは?
items.example: What does success look like for you by the end of the quarter?

items.theme: 相手の意図を確認する
items.ja: 分かりにくかった? (自分の説明が)
items.example: Did I lose you? Let me back up a step.
items.when: 相手の反応が薄いとき

items.theme: 相手の意図を確認する
items.en: Are we on the same page?
items.ja: 認識は合っている?
items.example: Are we on the same page about the launch date?

items.ja: 資料、よくできていた
items.example: Nice work on the deck. The client got it right away.

items.ja: 完璧だった
items.example: The demo? You nailed it.

items.en: I appreciate you jumping on this.
items.ja: すぐ対応してくれて感謝
items.example: I appreciate you jumping on this so fast.

items.en: Credit where it's due: that was Maria.
items.ja: 功績は正当に。あれはマリアの手柄
items.example: Credit where it's due: that was Maria's idea.

items.en: That saved us a lot of time.
items.ja: おかげでかなり時間が浮いた
items.example: Your template saved us a lot of time.

items.ja: 先に教えてくれてありがとう
items.example: Thanks for the heads-up about the client.

items.en: I couldn't have done it without you.
items.ja: あなたなしでは無理だった
items.example: Seriously, I couldn't have done it without you.

items.ja: よく気づいた
items.example: Great catch. That typo would have gone to the board.
items.when: ミスを拾ってくれたとき

items.ja: 期待以上にやってくれた
items.example: You went above and beyond on the audit.

items.ja: 借りができた(ありがとう)
items.example: Thanks for covering. I owe you one.

items.ja: 期限は動かない
items.example: The deadline is firm. The venue is booked.

items.en: What do you need to hit Friday?
items.ja: 金曜に間に合わせるには何が必要?
items.example: What do you need from me to hit Friday?
items.when: 支援を申し出つつ期限を固定

items.ja: 日付を確定しよう
items.example: Let's lock the date so everyone plans around it.

items.ja: 水曜以降は変更なし
items.example: No more changes after Wednesday, or we miss print.

items.ja: ぎりぎりだ
items.example: We're cutting it close. Can we drop the extra review?
items.when: 余裕がないことを共有

items.en: If it slips, tell me today, not Friday.
items.ja: 遅れるなら今日言って、金曜ではなく
items.example: If it slips, tell me today, not Friday.

items.ja: 中間確認の日を決めよう
items.example: Let's agree on a checkpoint: Wednesday noon.

items.ja: 厳しいが、できる
items.example: Friday is a stretch, but doable if we skip the demo.

items.ja: もう一度の遅れは許されない
items.example: We can't afford another delay; the client is already nervous.

items.en: Done is better than perfect here.
items.ja: ここは完璧より完了
items.example: Done is better than perfect here. Ship the draft.
items.when: 品質より期限を優先する判断

items.ja: 始めましょう
items.example: Looks like everyone's on. Let's get started.

items.en: Three things on the agenda today.
items.ja: 今日の議題は3つ
items.example: Three things on the agenda today: budget, hiring, and the vendor.

items.ja: それは会議の外で話そう
items.example: Good point. Let's take that offline and keep moving.

items.ja: それは一旦置いておこう
items.example: Let's park that for now and come back if there's time.

items.ja: 時間が足りなくなってきた
items.example: We're running short on time, so quick decisions, please.

items.en: Priya, do you want to kick us off?
items.ja: プリヤ、最初に話してもらえる?
items.example: Priya, do you want to kick us off with the demo feedback?

items.ja: まとめると…
items.example: To recap: vendor B, contract by Tuesday, Maria owns it.

items.ja: この件の担当は誰?
items.example: Who owns this? I need one name.

items.ja: 異議は?
items.example: We'll go with option B. Any objections?

items.ja: 締めましょう
items.example: Let's wrap up. Notes will go out within the hour.

items.theme: メールの書き出しと締め
items.ja: 手短に一つ:
items.example: Quick one: can you confirm the venue by noon?

items.theme: メールの書き出しと締め
items.ja: 先ほどの電話の続きですが、
items.example: Following up on our call, here are the two options we discussed.

items.theme: メールの書き出しと締め
items.en: Looping in Dana, who owns the budget.
items.ja: 予算担当のダナをCCに入れます
items.example: Looping in Dana, who owns the budget for this.

items.theme: メールの書き出しと締め
items.example: Two things: the date moved, and we need your sign-off.

items.theme: メールの書き出しと締め
items.en: Let me know if that works.
items.ja: それで大丈夫か教えてください
items.example: I've moved the call to three. Let me know if that works.

items.theme: メールの書き出しと締め
items.en: Happy to jump on a call if easier.
items.ja: 電話の方が楽なら喜んで
items.example: Happy to jump on a call if easier than email.

items.theme: メールの書き出しと締め
items.ja: よろしくお願いします(先に感謝)
items.example: Thanks in advance for the quick turnaround.

items.theme: メールの書き出しと締め
items.ja: 了解、やります
items.example: Will do. You'll have it by Thursday.

items.theme: メールの書き出しと締め
items.ja: 承知しました
items.example: Noted, thanks. I'll update the schedule.

items.theme: メールの書き出しと締め
items.ja: (締めの定番) よろしく、ケン
items.example: Talk soon. Best, Ken
items.when: 米国のビジネスメールの最も一般的な結び
